ratings: Design judgments by signal function; not empirical causal effects

subsystemDesign.purpose: Execute declared algorithms while preserving the binary kernel boundary.
subsystemDesign.parts: G8: 1,000-bit state, instruction compiler, VM, messages and clock. G7: sentence compiler and VM. G6: environments, internal layers, numeric fields and signed edges. G10: PID registers, drivers and binary plant. G11: algorithm catalogue, node state, parameters and synchronous coupling.
subsystemDesign.contract: Declared configuration and inputs → next state, binary output and evidence. Numerical registers belong to the relevant algorithm adapter, not implicit meaning in the binary cells.
subsystemDesign.verification: Binary bounds; deterministic replay; prior-state immutability; full-state export/import continuation.

subsystemDesign.purpose: Compose processes above the engine; keep definitions separate from running instances.
subsystemDesign.parts: Rule workshop: identity, truth table, validation, saved definitions. Registry: versioned definitions and installation. Flow runtime: typed ports, edge validation, queues, delay ticks and trace. Wiring editor: connect, disconnect and save. General blank canvas and reusable composite modules: proposed.
subsystemDesign.contract: Definitions + graph + commands → validated instances and routed messages. A process has inputs, state, algorithm and outputs.
subsystemDesign.verification: Reject incompatible ports and immediate cycles; bound messages; preserve explicit delays; reject invalid imports atomically.

subsystemDesign.purpose: Make behavior inspectable and compare explanations against controlled evidence.
subsystemDesign.parts: G9: descriptors, exact recurrence, matched interventions and annotation status. Metrics: snapshots and displays. Notebook: observer hypotheses. Exports: configurations and evidence. Experiment tools: edge ablations, baselines and replay.
subsystemDesign.contract: State and run configuration → observations, comparisons and provenance. A descriptor is not proof of emergence.
subsystemDesign.verification: Known fixtures; matched initial states; non-mutating comparisons; explicit hypothesis status and reproducible exports.

subsystemDesign.role: S3 control / S4 adaptation / S5 identity
subsystemDesign.purpose: Manage technical decisions, verification, risk and changes while retaining the engine purpose.
subsystemDesign.parts: Foundation: purpose and research. Feature inventory: responsibilities and connections. References: external knowledge. Tests and CI: verification. Git history: configuration baseline. Deployment service: release boundary. Automated resource policy, compatibility migration and runtime health supervisor: proposed.
subsystemDesign.contract: Needs and evidence → requirements, architecture decisions, acceptance checks and reviewed releases. People retain policy authority.
subsystemDesign.verification: Requirement-to-test traceability; versioned baselines; release checks; rollback source. VSM is a design analogy, not a claim of autonomous viability.

subsystemDesign.purpose: Expose processes without changing what the engine means.
subsystemDesign.parts: Navigation and home: page organization. Module views: controls and state display. Controllers: categorized actions and guards. Spatial viewer: camera, 3D volume, WebXR and desktop fallback. Logo and shell: identity.
subsystemDesign.contract: User intent → validated command; model snapshot → accessible view. A webpage is an interface, not necessarily a separate processor.
subsystemDesign.verification: Keyboard and screen-reader checks; routing/history; controller guards; simulated XR. Physical headset validation remains separate.

dynamicsDesign.status: Implemented in specific engines; signs and gains are configuration dependent.

dynamicsDesign.outflow: Explicit workflow advance; disabling an edge removes pending messages
dynamicsDesign.feedback: Queue growth → proposed resource supervisor → producer throttling
dynamicsDesign.status: Bounded queues and explicit advance implemented; adaptive throttling proposed.

dynamicsDesign.outflow: Removal or replacement under registry rules
dynamicsDesign.feedback: Test result → revise definition → test again
dynamicsDesign.status: Human-guided iteration; no autonomous algorithm improvement claimed.
Human interpretation; no claim that accumulating records automatically increases knowledge.
